requirement.fact: The data ingestion pipeline is broken and does not run automatically.

narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The nightly ingestion job for point of sale scan lines used to run on schedule. It now stalls before the store list completes. I trigger the remaining batches by hand each morning to get the data into the warehouse. This happens before the forecast job starts, so the morning order window still sees the full dataset.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational status of the ingestion job and the manual workaround in place, without expressing a wish, refusal, or specific trade-off.
